description:
Create a price alert, an event alert, a clock, or a trailing alert.

    Calling this stores the alert. A clock may omit the ticker.

    Args:
        symbol: Stock symbol (e.g. "AAPL"). Required for price and event alerts. Optional for a clock.
        alert_type: "target_price", "movement_pct", "event", "schedule", or "trailing"
        direction: For price alerts: "above", "below", or "either". For trailing: "long" or "short".
            Long trails the high since arming; short trails the low. Fires when price gives
            back trail_pct percent or trail_amount from that extreme.
        threshold: Required for price alerts — price level or percentage move. Not used for trailing.
        notes: Optional description. Not the agent instruction.
        event_types: Required when alert_type is "event". Live-tape ids such as
            filing_13f, politician_senate, options_unusual, ipo_upcoming.
        event_filters: Optional slices. Example: {"politician_senate": {"type": ["purchase"]}}.
            An omitted field matches every value.
        name: Optional title. Blank is filled from the rule.
        agent_instruction: What the agent does when this fires. Empty means notify only.
        max_fires: How many fires before it leaves Active. Omit to keep a repeating alert firing.
        schedule_at: ISO time. Required when alert_type is "schedule".
        schedule_tz: IANA zone. UTC when omitted.
        schedule_repeat: once, daily, weekdays, weekly, or monthly. Default once.
        skill_id: Strategy id this alert belongs to. Required when rule_ref is set.
        rule_ref: The section tag of the strategy rule this alert serves; the agent
            reads that section when the alert fires (STRATEGY_ALERTS=1).
        off_hours: "defer" (wake at next session open) or "now" (act while closed).
            Used when ALERT_OFF_HOURS=1 and the alert has an agent instruction.
        trail_pct: Trailing give-back percent (0 < x <= 50). Exactly one of trail_pct or trail_amount.
        trail_amount: Trailing give-back absolute amount (> 0). Exactly one of trail_pct or trail_amount.
        activate_at: Optional price that must be reached before trailing starts.

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: create_alert
title: Create alert
